limits: This is an exact retained-payload mask comparison using the repository native geographic scan, not an execution of the complete delivery constructor and not a claim of current legal authority.
All decoded payloads were parsed as complete GeoJSON in memory; only properties and per-key membership identities are retained in this output. Raw coordinates/geometries are not emitted.
Source feature contact indices are preserved separately from all-feature mask matches; a key inside a same-country but noncontact feature is not automatically classified as repairable.
The official Belgian administrative ZIP comparison remains unavailable: its one approved attempt ended at ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT after an outer timeout; no file was received and no retry was made.
The separate official Luxembourg canton comparison is a different vintage/source and does not replace this original-source check or determine the Belgian contact result.
The exact 624-key input set was independently compared to the retained block-021 source/physical/water witness join; the observation-derived target set has zero symmetric difference from those rows.

The native source scan is positive source-membership evidence for the complete LUX family; it does not itself supply source_evidence/native_patch constructor inputs, whole-target physical execution custody, or resolution of the 26 foreign source overlays.

stock_positive_path_bindings.source_evidence: Required immutable source-target evidence-v1/v2/v3 body with complete original target roster, whole original catalogue, complete source candidate membership/lineage, physical inputs, reproduction program and actual physical evidence; currently not found among retained LUX packet/observation outputs.
stock_positive_path_bindings.native_patch: Required exact constructed original-key additive rows joined to complete native contract, owner roster, source membership and physical class; current owner observation is not a native patch. No LUX native_patch artifact found.
stock_positive_path_bindings.available_now: Authenticated 2017 source bodies and exact mask/identity joins, original queue source/physical/water masks, full accepted source membership/lineage report, current official canton comparison, condominium diagnostic, and selected-owner observation.
stock_positive_path_bindings.authority_rules: Stock constructor accepts exact source_evidence plus native_patch immutable pins; it does not require a generic external authority certificate. Passing it still requires the substantive source/physical/native predicates to validate.
stock_positive_path_bindings.physical_gap: Retained block-021 physical-support mask classifies all 624 keys as land, but a mask is not an execution receipt for a whole-target physical producer. No such LUX receipt was located in the inspected retained paths.
stock_positive_path_bindings.foreign_contact_gap: All 25 BEL/LUX keys overlap Wallonne Gewest as well as LUX in retained source geometry. The approved exact Belgian boundary archive has not been acquired; no result can be claimed for that comparison. The DEU triple-match and separate condominium exclusion remain a distinct conflict.
